source: can U make a 3d game where the people are R15 and there's walls and truss U can climb and some high platforms

image_prompt.text: A chain of platforms spaced within jump limits, including the high platforms the climb leads up to
Platforms that vanish a set time after being stepped on
Climbable walls and metal trusses used to gain height between platforms
A reward area at the top of the climb

layout_placement.text: The end reward volume at the top of the climb

notes: Shape was not stated. Tower was taken with the preset; a terraced hillside course would be cheaper (P6 + tiered instead of P6 + P2) and is worth confirming.
The prompt requires R15 characters, which changes reach and hitbox size that P6 spacing depends on.

answers.ask: Should the climb stack straight up like a tower, or wind up a hillside in terraces?
answers.answer: Make it a straight-up tower so the trusses and high platforms are easy to climb.
